headline: Bitcoin slid further below $60,000 on Saturday and the Trump-linked WLFI token crashed more than 50%, with both main crypto fear gauges reading extreme fear.

market.asOf: BTC read on CoinMarketCap and SOL on CoinDesk at about 11:50 UTC Sat 28 Nov (18:50 Bangkok; 6:50am ET). CoinMarketCap's ether page gave conflicting figures within minutes ($1,646 down 4.27%, then $1,741 up 2.47%), so ether is CoinGecko's 06:43 UTC reading as reported by Cryptoticker. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Two indexes, both in extreme fear: alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed 12 (Extreme Fear) and CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed 9, both read at about 11:50 UTC 28 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin slides further below $60,000 as fear gauges read extreme fear
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell again on Saturday morning, ether fell harder, and the whole crypto market was down about 2% in a day.
points: Bitcoin was down 4.1% at $59,151.4 at 06:36 ET (11:36 GMT) on Saturday, per Investing.com.
The total crypto market fell 2% to $2.144 trillion over 24 hours, and $458 million of derivatives positions were liquidated, $273 million of them bets on rising prices, per TokenPost.
Ether lost 4.2% to $1,659 on Saturday morning, per Cryptoticker.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds' eight-day exodus tops $3.4 billion; MSCI drops Strategy at Monday's close
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds lost another $389 million on Friday, their eighth straight day of withdrawals, in a record month for outflows. After Monday's close, MSCI removes bitcoin treasury company Strategy from its indexes, which could make funds that track them sell its shares.
points: Spot bitcoin funds had net outflows of $389 million on 27 Nov, the eighth straight day, led by $327 million from BlackRock's IBIT, per TokenPost.
From 17 to 27 Nov the funds lost $3.44 billion, and IBIT's $2.79 billion was 81% of it, per CoinTurk.
November's outflows reached about $5.78 billion, above the previous monthly record set in June, per Pluang.

MSCI's changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov; funds tracking MSCI indexes hold about 3.1% of Strategy's shares. A JPMorgan estimate of about $2.8 billion of selling dates from 2025 and an earlier version of the plan, per Cryptoticker.

stories.title: Trump-linked WLFI token crashes more than 50%; its USD1 stablecoin briefly slips to 94 cents
stories.summary: World Liberty Financial's WLFI token fell to a record low overnight after a wallet labelled as the project's reserve sold ether at a loss, and its dollar stablecoin briefly lost its $1 peg. Tron founder Justin Sun accused insiders of cashing out.
points: WLFI fell 52.9% over 24 hours to $0.01956, per CoinGlass data cited by crypto.news.
CoinDesk puts WLFI down roughly 95% from its September 2025 peak of $0.33; TokenPost measures from an all-time high near $0.46 and puts the drop at almost 96%.
A wallet labelled "World Liberty Financial: Strategic Reserve" sold 12,121 ETH for about $20.06 million, a realized loss CoinDesk estimates at $19.26 million, citing EmberCN and Arkham.
The USD1 stablecoin briefly traded at $0.94, per TokenPost; World Liberty had not responded to CoinDesk's request for comment.

briefs.title: Abu Dhabi court weighs frozen Binance-hack funds Tuesday
briefs.summary: On 1 Dec an Abu Dhabi court hears whether 18 named firms must hand over frozen funds linked to Binance's October hack, per Cryptoticker.

briefs.title: CZ admits security complacency
briefs.summary: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao acknowledged complacency over the $6.3 billion hack and warned of another six to 12 months of heightened security threats, per The National.

briefs.title: Big holders kept buying
briefs.summary: Wallets holding 1,000 to 10,000 BTC added 121,117 BTC between 30 Sep and 21 Nov, to 2.95 million BTC, per CryptoQuant data cited by Investing.com.

briefs.title: XRP funds buck the trend
briefs.summary: US XRP funds drew $5.4 million of net inflows while bitcoin funds lost money, per Pluang.

briefs.title: Malaysia's first spot bitcoin fund eyes a 2 Dec debut
briefs.summary: The Halogen Shariah Bitcoin ETF is aiming to list on Bursa Malaysia's Main Market on 2 Dec, per The Edge Malaysia, based on its draft prospectus.

briefs.title: KuCoin delists Monero on Monday
briefs.summary: KuCoin removes its XMR spot pairs at 08:00 UTC on 30 Nov; withdrawals stay open until 31 Dec, per KuCoin.

calendar.note: The Fed's blackout runs from Sat 28 Nov to Thu 10 Dec, per the St. Louis Fed's blackout calendar; the Fed's December calendar lists Bowman's testimony on 1 Dec.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: PROS, FF, CARDS, GRVT, KMNO, GUN, EIGEN, SUI, ZETA, BTW, ENA, 2Z, Q, STO, MMT, LA
calendar.note: PROS on Saturday 28; FF and CARDS on Sunday 29; GRVT, KMNO and GUN on Monday 30 (trackers disagree on GUN's day); EIGEN, SUI and ZETA on Tuesday 1 Dec; BTW, ENA, 2Z and Q on Wednesday 2 Dec; STO on Thursday 3 Dec; MMT and LA on Friday 4 Dec; a second ENA tranche on Saturday 5 Dec. See the unlock table on this page for sizes and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)
OPEC says "The next meeting will be held on 29 November 2026." Time not announced.
Polls close at 20:00 CET, with a first official count around 21:00 CET. 176 of 350 seats are needed for a majority; most polls point to a PP-Vox majority, per Newsquawk.
XMR spot pairs are removed at 08:00 UTC; withdrawals stay open until 08:00 UTC 31 Dec, per KuCoin.

calendar.event: Trump Media (DJT) noteholders can demand repayment
calendar.note: About $883.5 million of convertible notes remain outstanding and holders may require repurchase for cash on 30 Nov, per Finviz. Time not published.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Takes effect after the close on 30 Nov. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million MSTR shares, about 3.1% of its shares; JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed's Bowman testifies to the House
calendar.note: ISM: consensus 55.2, October 55.5, per Newsquawk and Economic Weekly. JOLTS: September was 7.5 million, per the BLS. Bowman testifies on oversight of prudential regulators at 10:00am, per the Fed's calendar. An Abu Dhabi court hearing on the frozen Binance-hack tokens is also on 1 Dec, per TokenPost. Marvell holds its results call at 4:30pm ET, per Marvell.

calendar.event: ADP private payrolls (Nov); Salesforce and Snowflake earnings
calendar.note: ADP: consensus 80,000, October 86,000, per Economic Weekly. Salesforce and Snowflake report after the close, per the companies.

calendar.event: US jobless claims; ISM services PMI (Nov); Jensen Huang at Senate Banking
calendar.note: Claims: consensus 193,000, prior 189,000. ISM services at 10:00am: consensus 54.5, October 54.5. Both per Economic Weekly. Huang testifies to the Senate Banking Committee at 10:00am, per Newsquawk.
Consensus +90,000 jobs with unemployment at 4.1%; October was +165,000 and 4.1%, per Economic Weekly. Newsquawk also sees average hourly earnings +0.3% on the month.

calendar.event: Fed decision (8-9 Dec meeting); Powell press conference at 2:30pm
calendar.note: The Fed's December calendar lists the statement at 2:00pm ET and the press conference at 2:30pm ET. Newsquawk says a 25bp hike is fully priced for December. November CPI follows on Thu 10 Dec at 8:30am ET, per the BLS schedule, so the Fed decides before seeing it.

verification.method: Independent source check: every claim re-opened at its cited URL
